description: This file defines a React functional component 'SqlEditor' for the SQL editing interface in Apache Superset's SqlLab. It manages query editing, execution, hotkeys, UI layout, and related actions.

methods.name: startQuery
methods.description: Initiates a query execution, optionally as a CTAS (Create Table As) or CTV (Create View As).

methods.name: formatCurrentQuery
methods.description: Formats the current SQL query, optionally via shortcut.

methods.name: stopQuery
methods.description: Stops the currently running query if any.

methods.name: runQuery
methods.description: Triggers execution of the current query.

methods.name: getHotkeyConfig
methods.description: Defines keyboard shortcuts for query actions like run, stop, new tab, format, and switch tabs.

methods.name: onBeforeUnload
methods.description: Handles cleanup or query cancellation when the window unloads.

methods.name: loadQueryEditor
methods.description: Loads the query editor state from persistence if needed.

methods.name: getQueryCostEstimate
methods.description: Dispatches an action to estimate query cost.

methods.name: handleToggleAutocompleteEnabled
methods.description: Toggles the SQL autocomplete feature.

methods.name: handleToggleRenderHTMLEnabled
methods.description: Toggles the rendering of HTML in query results.

methods.name: createTableAs
methods.description: Executes a CREATE TABLE AS query.

methods.name: createViewAs
methods.description: Executes a CREATE VIEW AS query.

methods.name: ctasChanged
methods.description: Handles input change for the CTAS/CTV name.

methods.name: getSecondaryMenuItems
methods.description: Builds the secondary context menu with options like render HTML, autocomplete, format, schedule, and shortcuts.

methods.name: onSaveQuery
methods.description: Saves the current query.

methods.name: renderEditorPrimaryAction
methods.description: Renders primary action buttons for the editor, including run, save, and create options.

methods.name: renderEmptyAlert
methods.description: Displays a warning when no database is selected.

methods.name: handleCursorPositionChange
methods.description: Updates cursor position in the query editor state.

methods.name: copyQuery
methods.description: Copies current SQL query text.

methods.name: renderCopyQueryButton
methods.description: Renders the copy query button.

methods.name: renderDatasetWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning when editing a virtual dataset query.

methods.name: queryPane
methods.description: Renders the main query editing and results layout with splitter.
